findings.body: New evidence after the coordinator’s ruling leaves the root-cause requirement unfinished: commit f1bbc779 explicitly corrects the earlier claim, stating that injected PermissionError proves a possible stub failure, not the cause of job 111366127008, and that the original cause remains unconfirmed. The failing job’s log contains the premature-end symptom but no driver exception. I verified that run 37180349591 passed all five Windows groups, so the previous missing-CI check has evidence now; however, that passing run does not resolve the acknowledged root-cause gap. The added failure diagnostic helps investigation but does not complete it. Establish whether the reported failure follows the repaired replacement path and complete the corresponding repair and Windows verification while preserving the recovery assertions.
